steps.text: Sign in to your Adobe account in a web browser.
Choose Manage plan next to your plan.

steps.note: Annual plans can have a fee if you cancel early. Read the terms Adobe shows before you confirm.
Check the end date the service shows. Payments stop on the date you set.

steps.text: Check your email for a confirmation from Adobe.
steps.note: If you bought through a reseller or a work account, ask them. A team admin cancels team plans.
